_metadata.known_limitation: This lift is confounded: reaching a completed item at all (let alone on the intended carry) correlates with a game that was already going well (enough gold/rolls, no early elimination) — the lift measures a mix of the item's own effect and 'was able to build this item at all', and the two can't be separated from placement data alone. Augments are comparatively exogenous (offered from a small random set), so this concern is much weaker in augments.json than it is here.
